dropped.finding: The daemon's receipt propagation (record.update(_plan_review_sidecar_fields(gate_type, result))) depends on sidecar.emit() mutating in place the exact same verdict dict object the gate returns as `result` (emit sets verdict['sidecar_reviewed_at']; the caller separately sets verdict['sidecar_emitted']). This implicit shared-object coupling is undocumented and would silently break (findings.readable never becoming true / receipt lost) if the gate ever returned a copy of the verdict.
scenarios: A future refactor where the plan-review gate returns a validated/copied verdict rather than the same mutated dict.
